data.name: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 3
data.detailed_description:
The speedy and stylish action of the Luminous Avenger series is back!

Our hero Copen must use his new "Divide Edge" energy swords to protect his home from otherworldly invaders!

His trusty partner Lola is there to support him with evolutionary new modes!

Story

Copen, the Luminous Avenger.

After defeating the berserk AI dominating the world, he supports its new protector Blade, maintaining an uneasy peace.

Until one day when a young girl appears before him, begging for help, claiming to be from another world.

She warns him that his world will soon be under attack by countless invaders, the "iX Bearers"...

Feature 1 - All new weapon, "Divide Edge"

Copen wields a pair of energy blades, the Divide Edge.

These twin swords suit Copen's high-flying style perfectly, capable of combo attacks in mid-air, or combining into a single polearm for extended reach.

Feature 2 - Muse of Hope Lola's Seven Transformations

Lola now creates more than EX Weapons from defeated enemies: she also gets new modes.

Use her unprecedented variety of transformations to take on any challenge.
